sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area
fields.hint: Also applies to the maximum distance and height under Flight limits.

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

fields.label: Crawl speed
fields.hint: Descent speed in the last step. Firmware default 0.3.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

sections.title: Distance sensor

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.
presets.note: A DroneCAN node rather than a local driver: the autopilot subscribes to the messages it publishes, which is why the CAN stack itself has to be running. Wire it to a CAN port and mount it with the connectors pointing to the back of the vehicle. Set EKF2_OF_POS_X, _Y and _Z to where it sits relative to the centre of gravity. The numbers below are Holybro's own setup values for this module.
presets.wiring: Plug it into CAN 1 or CAN 2 with the 4-pin JST-GH cable. It has two CAN connectors, so further CAN devices can be chained behind it; the last device on the bus needs its termination on.

presets.label: Matek 3901-L0X
presets.summary: PMW3901 optical flow and a VL53L0X lidar, 0.08 to 2 m, on one UART speaking MSP v2.
presets.unsupported: PX4 has no MSP sensor input. The module speaks MSP v2, which INAV (2.3+) and ArduPilot (4.1+) read and PX4 does not. No parameter on this page can make its flow or distance data reach the estimator. For PX4, use a SPI PMW3901 board or a DroneCAN module.

presets.label: Benewake TFmini-S
presets.summary: 0.1 to 12 m time-of-flight rangefinder, ±6 cm, on one UART. PX4's TFmini driver uses readings from 0.4 to 12 m.
presets.note: Leave the module in its UART mode; PX4's driver does not read its I2C mode. Any free serial port will do. The baud rate is fixed in the driver, so there is nothing else to set.
presets.wiring: Plug it into a free serial connector, TELEM or GPS, and pick that connector below. The sensor's TX goes to the port's RX and its RX to the port's TX, plus 5 V and ground.

presets.label: Benewake TFmini Plus
presets.summary: 0.1 to 12 m time-of-flight rangefinder, ±5 cm, on one UART. PX4's TFmini driver uses readings from 0.4 to 12 m.
presets.note: Same driver and the same fixed baud rate as the TFmini-S, with a slightly tighter short-range accuracy. Leave it in UART mode.
presets.wiring: Plug it into a free serial connector, TELEM or GPS, and pick that connector below. The sensor's TX goes to the port's RX and its RX to the port's TX, plus 5 V and ground.

presets.label: Benewake TF03
presets.summary: 0.1 to 180 m time-of-flight rangefinder, ±10 cm, on one UART. PX4's TFmini driver uses readings from 0.4 to 12 m.
presets.note: The TF03 sends the same 9-byte Benewake frame at 115200 baud as the TFmini, so it runs on the TFmini driver. That driver treats anything past 12 m as out of range, so on PX4 this is a 12 m sensor. Its CAN mode is not read by PX4; keep the module in UART mode.

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.
presets.note: A DroneCAN node rather than a local driver: the autopilot subscribes to the messages it publishes, which is why the CAN stack itself has to be running. Wire it to a CAN port and mount it with the connectors pointing to the back of the vehicle. Set EKF2_OF_POS_X, _Y and _Z to where it sits relative to the centre of gravity. The numbers below are Holybro's own setup values for this module.
presets.wiring: Plug it into CAN 1 or CAN 2 with the 4-pin JST-GH cable. It has two CAN connectors, so further CAN devices can be chained behind it; the last device on the bus needs its termination on.

presets.unsupported: PX4 has no MSP sensor input. The module speaks MSP v2, which INAV (2.3+) and ArduPilot (4.1+) read and PX4 does not. No parameter on this page can make its flow or distance data reach the estimator. For PX4, use a SPI PMW3901 board or a DroneCAN module.

presets.wiring: Plug it into a free serial connector, TELEM or GPS, and pick that connector below. The sensor's TX goes to the port's RX and its RX to the port's TX, plus 5 V and ground.

sections.hint: Horizontal velocity from a downward camera, for position hold without GPS. It needs a distance sensor: without a height above ground the flow rate cannot be turned into a speed.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area
fields.hint: Also applies to the maximum distance and height under Flight limits.

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

fields.label: Crawl speed
fields.hint: Descent speed in the last step. Firmware default 0.3.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.
presets.note: A DroneCAN node rather than a local driver: the autopilot subscribes to the messages it publishes, which is why the CAN stack itself has to be running. Wire it to a CAN port and mount it with the connectors pointing to the back of the vehicle. Set EKF2_OF_POS_X, _Y and _Z to where it sits relative to the centre of gravity. presets.wiring: Plug it into CAN 1 or CAN 2 with the 4-pin JST-GH cable. It has two CAN connectors, so further CAN devices can be chained behind it; the last device on the bus needs its termination on.

sections.hint: Horizontal velocity from a downward camera, for position hold without GPS. It needs a distance sensor: without a height above ground the flow rate cannot be turned into a speed.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area
fields.hint: Also applies to the maximum distance and height under Flight limits.

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

fields.label: Crawl speed
fields.hint: Descent speed in the last step. Firmware default 0.3.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

sections.title: Distance sensor
sections.short: A downward lidar or sonar: height above the ground under the aircraft.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.
presets.note: A DroneCAN node rather than a local driver: the autopilot subscribes to the messages it publishes, which is why the CAN stack itself has to be running. Wire it to a CAN port and mount it with the connectors pointing to the back of the vehicle. Set EKF2_OF_POS_X, _Y and _Z to where it sits relative to the centre of gravity. The numbers below are Holybro's own setup values for this module.
presets.wiring: Plug it into CAN 1 or CAN 2 with the 4-pin JST-GH cable. It has two CAN connectors, so further CAN devices can be chained behind it; the last device on the bus needs its termination on.

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.
presets.note: A DroneCAN node rather than a local driver: the autopilot subscribes to the messages it publishes, which is why the CAN stack itself has to be running. Wire it to a CAN port and mount it with the connectors pointing to the back of the vehicle. Set EKF2_OF_POS_X, _Y and _Z to where it sits relative to the centre of gravity. The numbers below are Holybro's own setup values for this module.
presets.wiring: Plug it into CAN 1 or CAN 2 with the 4-pin JST-GH cable. It has two CAN connectors, so further CAN devices can be chained behind it; the last device on the bus needs its termination on.
presets.unsupported: This firmware does not carry UAVCAN_SUB_RNG, so the driver half of this module cannot be started from here.

presets.label: Matek 3901-L0X
presets.summary: PMW3901 optical flow and a VL53L0X lidar, 0.08 to 2 m, on one UART speaking MSP v2.
presets.unsupported: PX4 has no MSP sensor input. The module speaks MSP v2, which INAV (2.3+) and ArduPilot (4.1+) read and PX4 does not. No parameter on this page can make its flow or distance data reach the estimator. For PX4, use a SPI PMW3901 board or a DroneCAN module.

presets.label: Benewake TFmini-S
presets.summary: 0.1 to 12 m time-of-flight rangefinder, ±6 cm, on one UART. PX4's TFmini driver uses readings from 0.4 to 12 m.
presets.note: Leave the module in its UART mode; PX4's driver does not read its I2C mode. Any free serial port will do. The baud rate is fixed in the driver, so there is nothing else to set.
presets.wiring: Plug it into a free serial connector, TELEM or GPS, and pick that connector below. The sensor's TX goes to the port's RX and its RX to the port's TX, plus 5 V and ground.
presets.unsupported: This firmware does not carry SENS_TFMINI_CFG, so the driver half of this module cannot be started from here.

presets.label: Benewake TFmini Plus
presets.summary: 0.1 to 12 m time-of-flight rangefinder, ±5 cm, on one UART. PX4's TFmini driver uses readings from 0.4 to 12 m.
presets.note: Same driver and the same fixed baud rate as the TFmini-S, with a slightly tighter short-range accuracy. Leave it in UART mode.
presets.wiring: Plug it into a free serial connector, TELEM or GPS, and pick that connector below. The sensor's TX goes to the port's RX and its RX to the port's TX, plus 5 V and ground.
presets.unsupported: This firmware does not carry SENS_TFMINI_CFG, so the driver half of this module cannot be started from here.

presets.label: Benewake TF03
presets.summary: 0.1 to 180 m time-of-flight rangefinder, ±10 cm, on one UART. PX4's TFmini driver uses readings from 0.4 to 12 m.
presets.note: The TF03 sends the same 9-byte Benewake frame at 115200 baud as the TFmini, so it runs on the TFmini driver. That driver treats anything past 12 m as out of range, so on PX4 this is a 12 m sensor. Its CAN mode is not read by PX4; keep the module in UART mode.
presets.wiring: Plug it into a free serial connector, TELEM or GPS, and pick that connector below. The sensor's TX goes to the port's RX and its RX to the port's TX, plus 5 V and ground.
presets.unsupported: This firmware does not carry SENS_TFMINI_CFG, so the driver half of this module cannot be started from here.

sections.hint: Horizontal velocity from a downward camera, for position hold without GPS. It needs a distance sensor: without a height above ground the flow rate cannot be turned into a speed.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area
fields.hint: Also applies to the maximum distance and height under Flight limits.

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

fields.label: Crawl speed
fields.hint: Descent speed in the last step. Firmware default 0.3.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

sections.title: Distance sensor
sections.short: A downward lidar or sonar: height above the ground under the aircraft.

presets.label: Holybro H-Flow
presets.summary: PAA3905E1 optical flow and an AFBR-S50LV85D distance sensor on one board, 0.08 to 30 m, over a single CAN cable.
presets.note: A DroneCAN node rather than a local driver: the autopilot subscribes to the messages it publishes, which is why the CAN stack itself has to be running. Wire it to a CAN port and mount it with the connectors pointing to the back of the vehicle. Set EKF2_OF_POS_X, _Y and _Z to where it sits relative to the centre of gravity. The numbers below are Holybro's own setup values for this module.
presets.wiring: Plug it into CAN 1 or CAN 2 with the 4-pin JST-GH cable. It has two CAN connectors, so further CAN devices can be chained behind it; the last device on the bus needs its termination on.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area
fields.hint: Also applies to the maximum distance and height under Flight limits.

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

fields.label: Crawl speed
fields.hint: Descent speed in the last step. Firmware default 0.3.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

sections.title: Distance sensor
sections.short: A downward lidar or sonar: height above the ground under the aircraft.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence

fields.label: Action when leaving the area
fields.hint: Also applies to the maximum distance and height under Flight limits.

sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.
sections.inactive: The action is None, so leaving the area does nothing.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

options.label: Return at critical, land at emergency

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.

sections.title: Flight limits

fields.label: Maximum distance
fields.hint: Horizontal distance from home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Maximum height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle may reach. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Multicopter altitude ceiling
fields.hint: Hard altitude limit enforced by the multicopter land detector.

fields.label: Predict the breach
fields.hint: Act on where the current velocity is taking the vehicle, not only on where it already is.

sections.hint: The envelope the vehicle is not allowed to leave, measured from the home position. What it does at the limit is set on the Geofence card.

sections.title: Geofence
sections.hint: Draw the area the vehicle may fly in. Leaving it triggers the action below.

sections.title: Return to Launch

options.label: Mission landing or rally point, direct
Mission landing along the mission path

fields.label: Return height
fields.hint: Height above home the vehicle climbs to before flying back.

fields.label: Descend height
fields.hint: Height above home it descends to once it has arrived.

fields.label: Return cone
fields.hint: Close to home the return height is reduced along this cone, so a vehicle hovering overhead does not climb first.

fields.label: Loiter before landing
fields.hint: Seconds to hold at the descend height before landing. -1 loiters indefinitely.

fields.label: Loiter radius
fields.hint: Fixed-wing only.

sections.hint: The path home, flown on an RTL command and by every failsafe whose action is Return.

sections.title: Landing

fields.label: Descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of automatic descents before the landing itself, such as the descent after a return. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Maximum descent speed
fields.hint: Speed of the landing above the slowdown height. Also caps every other descent, manual ones too. Firmware default 1.5.

fields.label: Slowdown starts at
fields.hint: Height where the descent starts to slow down. Must be above the next height. Firmware default 10.

fields.label: Landing speed from
fields.hint: Height below which it descends at the landing speed. Firmware default 5.

fields.label: Landing speed
fields.hint: Descent speed down to the ground. Firmware default 0.7.

fields.label: Crawl below
fields.hint: Height of the last, slowest step. Used only with a distance sensor. Firmware default 1.

fields.label: Crawl speed
fields.hint: Descent speed in the last step. Firmware default 0.3.

sections.hint: How fast the vehicle may descend when it lands on its own (Land, Return and a mission landing), and the heights where it slows down. Below the slowdown it holds the landing speed until touchdown.

actions.label: Fast landing
actions.hint: Faster descent that still brakes early. Tuned for the Holybro X500 and X650. The values are written to the vehicle and stay editable below.

sections.title: Failsafe actions

fields.label: Position loss
fields.hint: Fallback when the position estimate is lost in Position mode.

fields.label: Reaction delay
fields.hint: Grace period between the failsafe condition and the action, so a brief dropout does not trigger a return.

fields.label: Auto-disarm after landing
fields.hint: Seconds after touchdown before the vehicle disarms itself. -1 disables it.

fields.label: Auto-disarm if not taking off
fields.hint: Seconds armed on the ground before disarming again.

sections.hint: What the autopilot does on its own when something is lost. Every action named Return flies the Return to Launch profile. The levels the low-battery action reacts to are on the Battery & Power page. Every BAT_ parameter lives there.
